# `federal_register_issues`

**Historical Federal Register issue observations**

One publisher issue metadata observation with advertised renditions and exact retained rendition references. Issue metadata does not replace document text or complete granule history.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Selected original issue metadata and retained renditions only; full issue document/granule history requires separate acquisition and qualification. *(measured 2026-10-10)*

- **Parquet file:** `federal_register_issues.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `issue_observation_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader identity of the publisher package and original issue metadata digest. |
| `package_id` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher Federal Register issue package identifier. |
| `publication_date` | `VARCHAR` | Publisher-stated issue publication date. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the original selected source bytes. |
| `metadata_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete native issue metadata retained as JSON. |
| `retained_renditions_json` | `VARCHAR` | Exact retained rendition URLs, digests and byte sizes; advertised renditions remain separate. |
| `source_bytes` | `BIGINT` | Decoded original source body size in bytes. |
